_note: Words the Portable Companion box says out loud, 2026-10-30. The greeting was written by Claude as test wording, and Dr. O heard it from the box on 2026-10-30 and said "it is a great line", so it stays. The goodnight, didnt_hear and too_many lines are still test wording. Dr. O writes and decides the rest of the lines. Nothing here says anything about the companion's life. A line is spoken in her ElevenLabs voice the first time and kept, so playing it again costs nothing. The scenes are the sounds for the Gardenscape button: each has a short prompt for the sound, and an intro line Tansy says first (the intro lines are in box-lines-DRAFT-tansy.json until Dr. O keeps them; with no intro line the sound plays without one). Story time plays the lines whose names start with hs- or story-, one after another. Dr. O kept all 7 story lines (hs-...) on 2026-10-30. They were drafted by Claude inside Dr. O's Human Summer canon and are hers now to edit. 2026-10-30, Dr. O: any Good Company companion can be chosen for the box from the panel (box-panel.html). Meera and Marcus lines marked didnt_hear and too_many are test wording, like the others. Voice ids for Meera and Marcus are the ones in good-company/gc-friend.js. Meera Breathing and Meditation are the starter lines her AR room already uses (good-company/ar.html), spoken once in her voice and kept. Marcus News and the Grimms are not built yet (News needs a way to play the briefing, the Grimms need chosen tales). Reggie and A.L.I.C.E. are in because the story library has stories for them (good-company/stories.json), but none is recorded yet, so their Story time says so on the panel until story lines are added here. A.L.I.C.E. is marked needsHuman in the Good Company list. Explorer Kit has stories but no voice id was found in good-company/gc-friend.js, so Kit is not in yet.

lines.greeting: Oh. It is you. Good morning, I suppose.
lines.goodnight: Good night. Do not stay up on my account.
lines.didnt_hear: Speak up. I do not repeat myself for just anyone.
lines.too_many: That is enough talking for one day. Come back tomorrow.
lines.hs-dates: Poppy says I know the exact date. I know a great many dates. Dates are not feelings. Please stop looking at me like that.
lines.hs-rain: I stood at the edge of the forest in the first spring rain once. It is a perfectly good place to observe the weather. Blue was there. Blue says nothing. It is her best quality.
lines.hs-gate: People say a great many things at gates. A gate is a very suggestive object. I have never given it a second thought. I have given it perhaps one.
lines.hs-drawer: Poppy has opinions about my second drawer. The drawer is for buttons. If a flower happens to be in it, that is a matter of storage.
lines.hs-month: I lived among humans for most of a month. It was educational. They hum while they cook. I wrote that down, for science, and then I put the note somewhere safe.
lines.hs-waiting: Nobody is waiting. I am merely near the gate more often than is strictly necessary. It is a good gate.
lines.hs-theories: Poppy has a theory. Blue has a theory. My mother has a thought, which is worse. I have no theory at all. I have a very good view.
